ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with high-intensity (white) linear and focal disruptions; estimated ratio of 9:1 black-to-white.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across ~95% of visible surface. Small contiguous white patches localized at the extreme lateral tip of the left lobe and a focal white highlight on the right trailing edge near the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central notch with an approximate pixel angle of 70-80 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular trailing edge topography. Right lobe exhibits high-amplitude, jagged rectangular and triangular indentations (macro-serrations). Left lobe shows finer, lower-amplitude irregular peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges sweeping upward and outward to sharp, slightly recurved lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of high-contrast white circular clusters (1-5 pixels in diameter) observed in the lower-central regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multidirectional, thin white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible across the entire ventral surface, with high concentrations on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged scarring along the trailing edge of the right lobe, consistent with macro-scale physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Set of three distinct, near-parallel vertical linear scratches located on the distal third of the left lobe.
